meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能通过 CDP 控制 Chrome 并复用你已有的登录态:打开网址、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、抓取页面文本和 auth token,也能点击和输入。启动前会先探测状态,若要杀掉正在运行的 Chrome 会先征求你同意。
howto.when: 当你需要浏览器自动化,或提到 CDP、浏览器操作、复用登录态等关键词时触发。首次启动若检测到 Chrome 正在运行,会先询问你是否同意关闭它。

say.text: 帮我在 9222 端口探测一下 CDP 状态
say.note: 只探测,不改动任何状态

say.text: 用 CDP 打开这个网址,等加载完把页面文本取回来
从浏览器本地存储里取出登录 token

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can control Chrome over CDP and reuse your existing login sessions: open URLs, wait for load, run JavaScript, read page text and auth tokens. It probes state first and asks consent before killing a running Chrome.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need browser automation or mention CDP, browser operations, or reusing login sessions. On first launch, if Chrome is already running, it asks for your consent first.

say_en.text: Check the CDP status on port 9222
Open this URL over CDP, wait for load, then return the page text
Pull the auth token from the browser's local storage
